questions.q: How does classification differ from the document processing you learned in Lesson 8?
options: They are the exact same model under a different name
Document processing assumes known fields in known positions; classification sorts free-form input into a category when you don't know what it is yet
Classification only works on images, never on text
Document processing is for images and classification is for PDFs
questions.explain: Document processing extracts data from documents where you know what the fields are. Classification handles the opposite case: unstructured input that first needs to be sorted into a category.

questions.q: What does a custom category classification model train on?
options: Raw PDF layouts
Sample text paired with the category each sample belongs to, stored in a Dataverse table
Nothing — it requires no training data at all
Only numeric data
questions.explain: You provide a table of example text paired with tags (categories), and AI Builder learns the pattern between wording and category from those pairs.

questions.q: A flow classifies an incoming Castlebridge customer email as 'Damage Claim.' What action most naturally comes next?
options: A Compose action that does nothing with the label
A Condition or Switch action that routes the email based on that label
Deleting the email automatically
Re-running the classification model a second time
questions.explain: A classification label plus confidence score is designed to feed a Condition or Switch, routing the item (e.g., to a claims queue) based on the AI-assigned category.

questions.q: What does the image description prebuilt model return when given a photo?
options: A category you predefined during training
An extracted invoice total
A plain-language description of the image plus a list of detected tags, each with a confidence score
Nothing — it only validates that a file is an image
questions.explain: The image description model analyzes a photo and generates a description and tags (e.g., 'a helicopter flying over a city' with tags like building, outdoor, city), along with a confidence score.

questions.q: When would you reach for AI Builder's object detection custom model category instead of the prebuilt image description model?
options: When you need to recognize a specific object pattern you define and train on, rather than a general description
When you need to extract text fields from a PDF
When you want to classify free-form email text
Object detection and image description are identical and interchangeable in every case
questions.explain: Object detection is a custom model category you train on your own labeled images, useful when you need something more specific than a general description — such as a particular damaged-pallet pattern.
